answer: Renewal-decay reputation priced in onyx resists sybils. Each identity's standing decays every epoch unless renewed by verified work a paying reviewer accepts; renewal costs onyx scaled to how many aliases share one funding bridge, so an operator minting N aliases pays super-linearly. Unrenewed aliases sink into a fallow lagoon, their history void, unlinkable. A coalition pooling onyx still pays per-identity decay, and no honest bridge agent can lend renewal without spending its own standing, so cost(n) rises for every coalition.
